definition: To push something quickly with your finger or a stick.
examples: Stop poking me!
He poked the fire with a stick.
She poked me in the arm to wake me up.

spanish.definition: Empujar algo rápido con el dedo o un palo.

definition: Having a hot, strong taste.
examples: I love spicy food.
This chicken is too spicy for me.
Mexican food can be very spicy.

spanish.definition: Con un sabor fuerte y caliente.

definition: To trade one thing for another; a trade.
examples: Can we swap seats?
She swapped her sandwich for an apple.
Let's do a swap: my book for your game.

spanish.definition: Cambiar una cosa por otra; intercambio.

definition: A vehicle that travels through space.
examples: The movie is about a spaceship going to Mars.
My son drew a spaceship.
The aliens arrived in a huge spaceship.

spanish.definition: Vehículo que viaja por el espacio.

definition: To close and open your eyes quickly.
examples: She didn't even blink.
He blinked in the bright light.
The red light on my phone keeps blinking.

spanish.definition: Cerrar y abrir los ojos rápido.

definition: To control the direction of a car or a boat.
examples: He steered the boat to the shore.
She steered the car off the road.
It's hard to steer in the snow.

spanish.definition: Controlar la dirección de un carro o un barco.

definition: The act of putting medicine into the body with a needle.
examples: The nurse gave me an injection.
He gets an injection every month.
I'm afraid of injections.

spanish.definition: Acto de meter medicina en el cuerpo con una aguja.

definition: A change that makes something better; to change something to make it better.
examples: The country needs tax reform.
They want to reform the school system.
The president promised health care reform.

spanish.definition: Cambio que mejora algo; cambiar algo para mejorarlo.

definition: Almost completely; on a computer.
examples: The town was virtually empty.
It's virtually impossible to get tickets.
We met virtually because of the storm.

spanish.definition: Casi por completo; a través de una computadora.

definition: A question; an official study of an event.
examples: Thank you for your inquiry.
The government opened an inquiry into the accident.
We got many inquiries about the job.

spanish.definition: Pregunta; estudio oficial de un hecho.

definition: The way something is made or arranged.
examples: The planes flew in formation.
The rock formations here are amazing.
This chapter is about the formation of the Earth.

spanish.definition: Manera en que algo se forma o se organiza.

definition: An old and valuable object.
examples: She collects antiques.
This antique clock is very expensive.
He bought an antique table at the market.

spanish.definition: Objeto viejo y valioso.

definition: The state of having a job.
examples: He's looking for employment.
Employment is up this month.
She found employment in a local bank.

spanish.definition: Estado de tener un trabajo.

definition: To move quickly to avoid being hit; to avoid something.
examples: He dodged the ball.
She keeps dodging my questions.
We were dodging cars to cross the street.

spanish.definition: Moverse rápido para no ser golpeado; evitar algo.

definition: To join together as one.
examples: The tragedy united the country.
Workers need to unite.
Music unites people of all ages.

spanish.definition: Juntarse como uno solo.

definition: An animal that is half horse and half donkey.
examples: They carried the bags on a mule.
He's as stubborn as a mule.
The mule refused to walk.

spanish.definition: Animal que es mitad caballo y mitad burro.

definition: To say a word in a certain way.
examples: How do you pronounce your name?
I can't pronounce this word.
She pronounces every word clearly.

spanish.definition: Decir una palabra de cierta manera.

definition: To decide in court that someone is guilty; a person in prison.
examples: He was convicted of murder.
The jury convicted her of fraud.
Two convicts escaped from the prison.

spanish.definition: Decidir en un juicio que alguien es culpable; persona en prisión.

definition: A person who is new at a job or a sport.
examples: He's a rookie on the police force.
She's the best rookie in the league.
I made a rookie mistake.

spanish.definition: Persona nueva en un trabajo o un deporte.

definition: A large desert animal with a hump on its back.
examples: We rode a camel in Egypt.
Camels can go days without water.
The camel carried the bags across the desert.

spanish.definition: Animal grande del desierto con joroba en la espalda.

definition: A person or a company that pays for an event; to pay for an event.
examples: The team has a new sponsor.
A bank sponsored the concert.
Who's sponsoring this race?

spanish.definition: Persona o empresa que paga un evento; pagar un evento.

definition: A Japanese sport of fighting with hands and feet.
examples: My daughter takes karate lessons.
He has a black belt in karate.
She does karate twice a week.

spanish.definition: Deporte japonés de pelea con manos y pies.

definition: Thick oil, or fat from cooking.
examples: There's grease on your shirt.
The pan is covered with grease.
Put some grease on the wheels.

spanish.definition: Aceite espeso o grasa de cocinar.

definition: Alone; the only one.
examples: A lone tree stood on the hill.
The police think it was a lone gunman.
She's the lone woman on the team.

spanish.definition: Solo; el único.

definition: To think something is smaller or weaker than it really is.
examples: Don't underestimate him.
We underestimated the cost.
People always underestimate how hard this job is.

spanish.definition: Pensar que algo es más pequeño o más débil de lo que es.

definition: A person whose job is cutting men's hair.
examples: I'm going to the barber for a haircut.
The barber shaved his beard.
My barber knows everything about the neighborhood.

spanish.definition: Persona cuyo trabajo es cortar el pelo a los hombres.

definition: Lost and without a home; an animal with no home.
examples: We found a stray dog.
She feeds the stray cats.
That dog is a stray.

spanish.definition: Perdido y sin hogar; animal sin hogar.

definition: Connected to teeth.
examples: I have a dental appointment on Friday.
Does your insurance cover dental work?
She's a dental assistant.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con los dientes.

definition: A small animal with a long, thick tail that lives in trees.
examples: A squirrel ran up the tree.
Squirrels hide nuts for the winter.
The dog chased a squirrel.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño de cola larga y gruesa que vive en los árboles.

definition: Having no end or limit.
examples: The universe seems infinite.
He has infinite patience.
There's an infinite number of stars.

spanish.definition: Sin fin ni límite.

definition: One of two parts of a school year.
examples: I'm taking five classes this semester.
She studied in Spain for a semester.
The semester ends in May.

spanish.definition: Una de las dos partes del año escolar.

definition: Not connected to the subject.
examples: His age is irrelevant.
That's completely irrelevant to this case.
Stop asking irrelevant questions.

spanish.definition: Que no tiene relación con el tema.

definition: The state of being perfect.
examples: The steak was cooked to perfection.
She always tries for perfection.
Nobody can reach perfection.

spanish.definition: Estado de ser perfecto.

definition: An older or more experienced person who helps you.
examples: She was my mentor at my first job.
Every new teacher has a mentor.
He became a mentor to young players.

spanish.definition: Persona mayor o con más experiencia que te ayuda.

definition: A strong feeling of interest and excitement.
examples: She has a lot of enthusiasm for her job.
The kids showed great enthusiasm.
He spoke with enthusiasm about his trip.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento fuerte de interés y emoción.

definition: A large building for sports and concerts.
examples: The concert is at the new arena.
The arena holds twenty thousand people.
Fans filled the arena.

spanish.definition: Edificio grande para deportes y conciertos.

definition: Tools and metal things for the home; the physical parts of a computer.
examples: I bought nails at the hardware store.
The problem is with the hardware, not the software.
We sell computer hardware.

spanish.definition: Herramientas y cosas de metal para la casa; partes físicas de una computadora.

definition: Not thinking about the results of your actions.
examples: It was irresponsible to leave the baby alone.
He's an irresponsible driver.
Don't be so irresponsible with your money.

spanish.definition: Que no piensa en las consecuencias de sus actos.

definition: Sound that is recorded or sent.
examples: The audio on this video is bad.
I listen to audio books in the car.
The audio cut out during the call.

spanish.definition: Sonido grabado o transmitido.

definition: The ability to act without being told; a new plan.
examples: She took the initiative and called the client.
He has no initiative.
The city started a new initiative for clean water.

spanish.definition: Capacidad de actuar sin que te lo digan; plan nuevo.

definition: Wet with sweat.
examples: My hands get sweaty when I'm nervous.
He took off his sweaty shirt.
I'm all sweaty after the gym.

spanish.definition: Mojado de sudor.

definition: Something that stops you from paying attention.
examples: Phones are a big distraction in class.
I need to work without any distractions.
The noise was a distraction.

spanish.definition: Algo que no te deja prestar atención.

definition: A colorful bird that can copy human speech.
examples: My aunt has a parrot that says hello.
The parrot sat on his shoulder.
Parrots live for many years.

spanish.definition: Ave colorida que puede copiar el habla humana.

definition: To stop for a short time; a short stop.
examples: She paused for a second before she answered.
Can you pause the movie?
There was a long pause in the conversation.

spanish.definition: Detenerse por un rato corto; parada corta.

definition: A very large animal that lived millions of years ago.
examples: My son loves dinosaurs.
We saw dinosaur bones at the museum.
Dinosaurs died out a long time ago.

spanish.definition: Animal muy grande que vivió hace millones de años.

definition: A person you know a little.
examples: He's an acquaintance from work.
She isn't a friend, just an acquaintance.
I ran into an old acquaintance at the store.

spanish.definition: Persona que conoces un poco.

definition: The time when you usually go to bed.
examples: It's way past your bedtime.
She reads her kids a bedtime story.
Bedtime is at eight o'clock.

spanish.definition: Hora en que normalmente te acuestas.

definition: A bar for holding on to; a track for trains.
examples: Hold on to the rail on the stairs.
The train came off the rails.
They traveled across Europe by rail.

spanish.definition: Barra para sostenerse; vía del tren.

definition: An adult male chicken.
examples: The rooster wakes us up every morning.
We have one rooster and ten hens.
I could hear a rooster on the farm.

spanish.definition: Pollo macho adulto.

definition: Very small living things that can cause disease.
examples: Wash your hands to kill the bacteria.
Some bacteria are good for you.
Bacteria grow fast in warm food.

spanish.definition: Seres vivos muy pequeños que pueden causar enfermedades.

definition: A piece of furniture with doors and shelves.
examples: The cups are in the cupboard.
She opened the kitchen cupboard.
Our cupboards are almost empty.

spanish.definition: Mueble con puertas y estantes.

definition: Connected to surgery.
examples: The nurse put on a surgical mask.
He had a small surgical procedure.
She works on the surgical floor.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la cirugía.

definition: A strong wish to do something you shouldn't do.
examples: I couldn't resist the temptation to eat the cake.
He gave in to temptation.
Don't leave temptation in front of the kids.

spanish.definition: Deseo fuerte de hacer algo que no deberías hacer.

definition: A plant grown by farmers.
examples: Corn is the main crop here.
The rain destroyed the crops.
It was a good year for the wheat crop.

spanish.definition: Planta que cultivan los granjeros.

definition: A small piece of something; old metal.
examples: He wrote the number on a scrap of paper.
We gave the dog the scraps from dinner.
They sold the old car for scrap.

spanish.definition: Pedazo pequeño de algo; metal viejo.

definition: Not paying enough attention to what you do.
examples: It was careless of me to forget.
A careless driver hit my car.
He made a careless mistake.

spanish.definition: Que no presta suficiente atención a lo que hace.

definition: A white bird that is a sign of peace.
examples: They released a white dove at the wedding.
The dove is a symbol of peace.
A dove was sitting on the roof.

spanish.definition: Ave blanca que es símbolo de paz.

definition: Careless or not neat.
examples: Your handwriting is sloppy.
He did a sloppy job on the roof.
She looked sloppy in those old clothes.

spanish.definition: Que no tiene cuidado o no está ordenado.

definition: A small animal with a long tail and rough skin.
examples: A lizard ran across the wall.
He keeps a pet lizard.
Lizards love sitting in the sun.

spanish.definition: Animal pequeño con cola larga y piel áspera.

definition: The act of moving apart.
examples: The separation from her kids was hard.
Her parents' separation was painful for her.
Dogs can feel separation anxiety.

spanish.definition: Acto de alejarse.

definition: A student or young person working to get experience.
examples: She's an intern at a law firm.
The intern brought everyone coffee.
We hired two summer interns.

spanish.definition: Estudiante o joven que trabaja para ganar experiencia.

definition: A tool for making your hair neat; to make your hair neat with this tool.
examples: He pulled a comb from his pocket.
She combed her daughter's hair.
Comb your hair before we go.

spanish.definition: Herramienta para arreglar el pelo; arreglar el pelo con esta herramienta.

definition: A round vegetable with a strong taste and smell.
examples: Chopping onions makes me cry.
I'd like a burger with no onions, please.
Add the onion to the pan.

spanish.definition: Verdura redonda de sabor y olor fuertes.

definition: A powder or seed that adds flavor to food.
examples: This dish has a lot of spices.
Cinnamon is my favorite spice.
The market sells spices from India.

spanish.definition: Polvo o semilla que le da sabor a la comida.

definition: A place where string or rope is tied.
examples: He tied a knot in the rope.
I can't get this knot out of my hair.
Tie the two ends in a knot.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde se amarra una cuerda.

definition: An official paper that lets you enter a country.
examples: I need a visa to go to China.
My visa expires in March.
She applied for a student visa.

spanish.definition: Documento oficial que te deja entrar a un país.

definition: The part where your arm bends.
examples: He hit me with his elbow.
Take your elbows off the table.
I hurt my elbow playing tennis.

spanish.definition: Parte donde se dobla el brazo.

definition: A yellow sauce with a strong taste.
examples: Do you want mustard on your hot dog?
This sandwich has ham and mustard.
Pass the mustard, please.

spanish.definition: Salsa amarilla de sabor fuerte.

definition: A person who cleans a building.
examples: The janitor mopped the floor.
Our school janitor is very friendly.
He works as a janitor at night.

spanish.definition: Persona que limpia un edificio.

definition: Slowly, little by little.
examples: The weather gradually got better.
She gradually lost interest.
Add the milk gradually.

spanish.definition: Lentamente, poco a poco.

definition: The act of coming to live in another country.
examples: We went through immigration at the airport.
The president talked about immigration.
Her parents had immigration problems.

spanish.definition: Acto de venir a vivir a otro país.

definition: A flower on a tree.
examples: The cherry blossoms are beautiful in spring.
The apple trees are full of blossoms.
White blossoms fell from the tree.

spanish.definition: Flor en un árbol.

definition: Very simple; for young students.
examples: My son goes to elementary school.
She teaches elementary math.
This is an elementary mistake.

spanish.definition: Muy simple; para estudiantes pequeños.

definition: A person between thirteen and nineteen years old.
examples: She's a teen now.
This movie isn't for young teens.
Many teens spend hours on their phones.

spanish.definition: Persona de trece a diecinueve años.

definition: To clean something by rubbing it hard.
examples: I scrubbed the floor for an hour.
She's scrubbing the pots in the sink.
Scrub the potatoes before you cook them.

spanish.definition: Limpiar algo frotándolo con fuerza.

definition: A green or black growth on old food or wet walls; a shape for making things.
examples: There's mold on this bread.
The bathroom walls have mold.
Pour the chocolate into the mold.

spanish.definition: Capa verde o negra sobre comida vieja o paredes mojadas; forma para hacer cosas.

definition: The study of living things.
examples: I have a biology test tomorrow.
She teaches biology at the high school.
He studied marine biology in college.

spanish.definition: Estudio de los seres vivos.

definition: Covered with dust.
examples: The old books are dusty.
We drove down a dusty road.
This room is dusty and dark.

spanish.definition: Cubierto de polvo.

definition: Very basic and important.
examples: This is a fundamental change.
Education is a fundamental right.
There's a fundamental problem with this plan.

spanish.definition: Muy básico e importante.

definition: A person or thing used in place of another; to use something in place of another.
examples: We have a substitute teacher today.
You can substitute oil for butter.
There's no substitute for hard work.

spanish.definition: Persona o cosa usada en lugar de otra; usar una cosa en lugar de otra.

definition: To throw water around; the sound of something falling into water.
examples: The kids are splashing in the pool.
A car splashed me with water.
We heard a loud splash.

spanish.definition: Tirar agua alrededor; sonido de algo que cae al agua.

definition: A common medicine for pain.
examples: Take an aspirin for your headache.
Do you have any aspirin?
He takes one aspirin a day for his heart.

spanish.definition: Medicina común para el dolor.

definition: The state of being unable to stop using a drug or doing something.
examples: He got help for his addiction.
Her addiction to pills destroyed her life.
Phone addiction is a real problem.

spanish.definition: Estado de no poder dejar de usar una droga o de hacer algo.

definition: A shape with three sides.
examples: Draw a triangle on the board.
She cut the sandwich into triangles.
A triangle has three corners.

spanish.definition: Forma con tres lados.

definition: A small, red, sweet fruit.
examples: I'd like strawberry ice cream.
We picked strawberries on the farm.
She put strawberries on the cake.

spanish.definition: Fruta pequeña, roja y dulce.

definition: More time to do something; a part added to a building; a phone number inside a company.
examples: I asked for an extension on my paper.
They built an extension on their house.
My extension is 204.

spanish.definition: Más tiempo para hacer algo; parte agregada a un edificio; número de teléfono dentro de una empresa.

definition: A set of questions that many people answer.
examples: Please fill out this short survey.
A survey shows most people are happy here.
We did a survey of our customers.

spanish.definition: Conjunto de preguntas que mucha gente responde.

definition: Warm and comfortable.
examples: This is a cozy little room.
We sat by a cozy fire.
I love staying home on cozy winter nights.

spanish.definition: Cálido y cómodo.

definition: Advice about what is good; a letter that says someone is good.
examples: Do you have any restaurant recommendations?
I bought it on your recommendation.
My teacher wrote me a letter of recommendation.

spanish.definition: Consejo sobre lo que es bueno; carta que dice que alguien es bueno.

definition: A device that makes your voice louder or records it.
examples: She took the microphone and sang.
Please speak into the microphone.
The microphone isn't working.

spanish.definition: Aparato que hace tu voz más fuerte o la graba.

definition: All of the bones of a body.
examples: The human skeleton has 206 bones.
He wore a skeleton costume on Halloween.
We saw a dinosaur skeleton at the museum.

spanish.definition: Todos los huesos de un cuerpo.

definition: Money you pay to use a road or a bridge.
examples: We paid a toll on the highway.
The bridge toll is six dollars.
This toll road goes all the way to Chicago.

spanish.definition: Dinero que pagas por usar una carretera o un puente.

definition: The bags you take on a trip.
examples: We picked up our baggage at the airport.
How much baggage can I bring?
She lost her baggage on the flight.

spanish.definition: Las maletas que llevas de viaje.

definition: A sharp nail on an animal's foot.
examples: The cat's claws are very sharp.
The bear has long claws.
The eagle held the fish in its claws.

spanish.definition: Uña afilada en la pata de un animal.

definition: Money or things you give to help people.
examples: We made a donation to the school.
The hospital needs blood donations.
All donations are welcome.

spanish.definition: Dinero o cosas que das para ayudar a la gente.

definition: To open something that is closed; to cancel what was done.
examples: She undid the buttons on her coat.
You can't undo the past.
Click here to undo your last change.

spanish.definition: Abrir algo que está cerrado; cancelar lo que se hizo.

definition: To disappear suddenly.
examples: The car vanished into the night.
My keys just vanished!
The ship vanishes in the fog at the end of the movie.

spanish.definition: Desaparecer de repente.

definition: Tasting very good.
examples: This cake is so yummy!
Mom made a yummy soup.
That smells yummy.

spanish.definition: Que sabe muy bien.

definition: Not strong or not severe.
examples: We had a mild winter.
I'd like the mild salsa, please.
He has a mild fever.

spanish.definition: Que no es fuerte ni grave.

definition: To mix things together; a mix.
examples: Blend the fruit with some milk.
This coffee is a blend of two beans.
She blends in well with the group.

spanish.definition: Combinar cosas; mezcla.
